changedReturnFollowup.observation: Metadata-based syscall deferral still times out. The changed-RSP probe pushes the published signal-frame RIP and returns to it. Trace original RIP is 0x201202 (kill syscall); disassembly places after_signal at 0x201204. Returning to the published address can resend the signal.
changedReturnFollowup.requiredCorrection: Distinguish completed syscall resume state from restartable syscall state when publishing the guest signal frame; preserve original host continuation separately. Validate unchanged and edited returns, syscall restart/error semantics and default Go preemption.
changedReturnFollowup.referenceScope: handle_signal rewinds instruction pointer for qualifying syscall restart errors before setup_rt_frame; this supports investigating why completed self-kill publishes the syscall address.
changedReturnFollowup.traceLimit: Diagnostic tracing exceeded intended bounds; agent instructed to limit emitted records. No diagnostic instrumentation is promotable.
